description: Search Hackshop's curated hardware reverse-engineering examples and research methods. With no query, returns the newest dated examples first. Evidence labels distinguish reproduced work, documented implementations, author demos and analysis methods; they do not imply compatibility with similar-looking hardware.

max_device_price_usd.description: Maximum lowest-listed device price in USD; unknown prices excluded. Accessories, host, shipping and tax are extra; availability is returned separately.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search across title, device, exact models, summary, outcome and tags. Empty returns the latest examples.

use_case.description: Filter source-backed design starters by intended use.

name: find_reverse_engineering_examples
title: Find reverse-engineering examples
